# Kestro UI

> Beautiful React + Tailwind CSS components for AI agents: chat, reasoning, tool calls, approvals, plans, voice and Jarvis-style HUDs.

Install: `npm i kestro-ui`. With Tailwind CSS v4 add `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "kestro-ui/theme.css";` to your CSS. Without Tailwind: `import "kestro-ui/styles.css"`. Dark mode: add the `dark` class to an ancestor. All components are named exports of `kestro-ui`.

Fastest path: `<AgentChat messages={messages} status={status} onSend={(text) => …} />` renders a complete agent chat. Messages are `{ id, role, content }` or `{ id, role, parts }` where parts follow the Vercel AI SDK UIMessage format (text, reasoning, tool-<name>, source-url, file, data-<name>).

- [Introduction](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/guides/introduction.md)

- [Theming](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/guides/theming.md)
- [Using with AI assistants](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/guides/ai.md)

## Chat

- [AgentChat](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-chat.md): A complete, batteries-included agent chat: thread, messages, reasoning, tools, approvals, sources, empty state, follow-ups and the prompt input. One component, works with any backend.
- [Message](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/message.md): A single chat message for user, assistant or system roles, with avatar, name, timestamp and hover actions (copy, feedback, regenerate).
- [Thread](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/thread.md): Scrollable message list that sticks to the bottom while content streams in, with a floating scroll-to-bottom button.
- [Markdown](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/markdown.md): Zero-dependency, safe Markdown renderer for LLM output: tables, task lists, code, citations. StreamingMarkdown adds a smooth, frame-paced reveal for bursty token streams.
- [CodeBlock](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/code-block.md): Syntax-highlighted code with copy button, filename, line numbers and a streaming caret. Built-in tiny highlighter, no dependencies.
- [TypingIndicator](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/typing-indicator.md): Animated three-dot indicator for when the agent is preparing a response.

## Input

- [PromptInput](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/prompt-input.md): Auto-growing composer with attachments (button, drag & drop, paste), stop button while streaming, voice button and toolbar slots.
- [ModelSelector](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/model-selector.md): Keyboard-accessible dropdown for choosing a model, agent, persona or mode.
- [Suggestions](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/suggestions.md): Starter prompts and follow-ups as compact chips or descriptive cards.
- [EmptyState](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/empty-state.md): Welcome screen shown before the first message.
- [Attachment](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/attachment.md): File chips with type-aware icons, image previews, upload progress and errors.

## Agent transparency

- [Reasoning](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/reasoning.md): Collapsible thinking block with live shimmer, last-line preview and automatic duration.
- [ToolCall](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/tool-call.md): Shows a tool invocation with arguments, result, status and duration. Pass children to render custom results (generative UI).
- [ToolCallRow](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/tool-call-row.md): Compact, single-line tool status for dense lists and dashboards, with progress, duration and retry.
- [Sources](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/sources.md): Citations: collapsible source list, source cards, chips and inline numbered citations with hover previews.

## Human in the loop

- [ToolApproval](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/tool-approval.md): Ask the user before the agent acts: payments, emails, bookings, deletions, shell commands. Supports details, previews, risk levels and 'remember' choice.
- [AgentQuestion](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-question.md): The agent asks the user a structured question: single or multiple choice, with optional free text.
- [HandoffBanner](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/handoff-banner.md): Escalate a conversation from the AI to a human specialist.

## Usage & cost

- [TokenUsage](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/token-usage.md): Token breakdown — input, cached, reasoning, output — with per-kind cost from your pricing. TokenCounter is the inline version.
- [ContextWindow](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/context-window.md): What's filling the model's context — system prompt, tools, files, conversation — as a bar or a 100-cell grid, with a warning before it runs out.
- [ModelUsageTable](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/model-usage.md): Usage per model: requests, input and output tokens, latency, share of spend and cost, with totals.
- [UsageChart](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/usage-chart.md): Stacked bars of tokens or spend over time, split by model or agent, with hover readouts.
- [StatTile](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/stat-tile.md): Dashboard KPI tile: label, big value, trend and sparkline.
- [Metric chips](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/metric-chips.md): Tiny inline building blocks: cost, latency, duration, speed, requests, trends, context, mini bars, model and agent chips, and a one-line message footer.

## Time

- [RunTimer](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/run-timer.md): Live elapsed timer for a run, with an estimate of time left and an optional timeout ring.
- [LatencyBreakdown](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/latency-breakdown.md): Where the time went in one response: queue, first token, tools and generation, plus tokens per second.

## Agents & models

- [AgentCard](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-card.md): Agent profile: identity, live status, model, tools and key stats, with actions.
- [AgentPicker](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-picker.md): Searchable, keyboard-friendly list for choosing which agent handles something.
- [ModelCard](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/model-card.md): Model spec card: context size, price per 1M tokens, speed, quality and capabilities.
- [ModelCompare](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/model-compare.md): Side-by-side model table that highlights the best value in each column.

## Tasks

- [TaskCreator](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/task-creator.md): Hand an agent a job: what to do, which agent, when it runs (now, scheduled or repeating), what it may do without asking, and a spend limit.
- [TaskBoard](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/task-board.md): Kanban board of agent tasks — Queued, Running, Needs you, Done — with drag and drop and live progress.
- [TaskList](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/task-list.md): Dense table of agent tasks with status, agent, progress, schedule and row actions.

## Workflows

- [TaskPlan](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/task-plan.md): Vertical timeline of an agent's plan with live step states and rich step content (e.g. approvals).
- [RunCard](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/run-card.md): One agent run at a glance: title, run id, status chip and a step timeline that can hold tool calls and approvals.
- [AgentHeader](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-header.md): Agent identity with live state badge and actions.
- [UsageMeter](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/usage-meter.md): Token, credit or context-window usage as a card, bar or compact ring.
- [SegmentedMeter](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/segmented-meter.md): Block-style meter for context windows, quotas and budgets.
- [ActivityFeed](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/activity-feed.md): Chronological log of what the agent did.
- [Artifact](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/artifact.md): Panel for generated documents, code, itineraries or reports with tabs, copy and download.
- [ConversationList](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/conversation-list.md): Sidebar of threads grouped by date, with search, new chat, running and unread states.

## Multi-agent

- [AgentGraph](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-graph.md): Animated tree of agents: who delegated to whom, who is working, and where work is flowing. Lays itself out and scales to fit. Click any agent for a popover with its activity, model, token usage and steps.
- [AgentHub](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-hub.md): Hub-and-spoke view of an orchestrator reaching out to the agents it coordinates, with swaying connections and live work packets. Click any agent for a popover with its activity, model, token usage and steps.
- [TraceTree](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/trace-tree.md): Nested trace of agent, LLM, tool and retrieval spans with a live waterfall timeline. Running spans grow in real time.
- [AgentAvatar](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-avatar.md): Avatar with live status (online, working, waiting, error, offline) and gradient agent tile.
- [AgentRoster](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-roster.md): A team of agents with roles, states and what each one is doing right now.
- [AgentHandoff](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-handoff.md): Inline divider showing control passing from one agent to another.

## Images

- [ImageGallery](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/image-gallery.md): Grid for one or many images in a message, with a shared lightbox and an optional 'Ask about this image' action that references the image in the composer.
- [Lightbox](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/lightbox.md): Full-screen image viewer: zoom with wheel, pinch, double-click or buttons, drag to pan, arrow keys to browse, captions and download. ImagePreview opens it from a single thumbnail.

## Voice

- [VoicePanel](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/voice-panel.md): A full voice-call surface with animated orb, status, transcript and call controls. Includes VoiceOrb and VoiceWave.
- [VoiceDial](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/voice-dial.md): Instrument-style dial for voice agents: ticked bezel, level disc and speaking ripples.

## HUD

- [AgentCore](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/agent-core.md): Arc-reactor style presence for an AI agent. Reacts to state, live loudness and a real audio spectrum from the microphone or TTS output.
- [AttitudeIndicator](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/attitude-indicator.md): An aviation attitude indicator as agent presence: the horizon steadies when idle, rolls while thinking and responds to audio. The bezel pointer shows any 0–100 value.
- [HudPanel](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/hud-panel.md): Sci-fi framed panel with corner brackets, scanlines and glow, plus an ambient HudBackground grid.
- [RadialGauge](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/radial-gauge.md): Animated 270° gauge for telemetry like confidence, CPU or context window.
- [HudStat](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/hud-stat.md): Telemetry readout with big mono value, delta and live sparkline.
- [TelemetryChart](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/telemetry-chart.md): Big readout plus a gridded line chart for latency, throughput, success rate or cost.
- [Waveform](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/waveform.md): Audio bars from live levels or synthesized from loudness.
- [CommandConsole](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/command-console.md): Terminal-style command line with history, typed streaming output and line kinds.
- [EventLog](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/event-log.md): Structured event stream (event name + key=value fields) for agent runs and audit trails.
- [BootSequence](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/boot-sequence.md): Animated startup checklist for 'agent waking up' moments.
- [DataTicker](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/data-ticker.md): Continuously scrolling status strip.

## Embed

- [ChatWidget](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/chat-widget.md): Floating launcher + chat panel to put an agent on any website.

## Primitives

- [Button](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/button.md): Buttons and icon buttons with variants, sizes and loading state.
- [Switch](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/controls.md): Switch and SegmentedControl — the toggles used by settings, permissions and task forms.
- [Badge](https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/components/badge.md): Badges, status dots, spinner, shimmer text, keyboard keys and tooltips.
